replay_guard.structural_finding: Phase 1 (PR claude/prod-promotion-phase1-replay-guard): replay_guard.py is OFF the live authority path; src/state/nonces.py (the `nonces` surface) is the running replay authority. Added tests/runtime/test_replay_guard_nonce_refinement_binding.py binding replay_guard.py = nonces.py on the SINGLE-TRANSITION domain (11/11, CI-gated). Two open gaps block any clear: (1) CONSENSUS reject-precedence seam: admit checks sender-before-nonce, the batch checks nonce-before-sender, so a double-fault input reports a different reject reason (both still reject + no-op). Reject precedence is part of the consensus contract; a canonical order must be declared. (2) cross-sender batch ATOMICITY (all-or-nothing rollback) is the live authority's distinctive behavior and has NO proof (the chain reaches only the single-transition slice; strictly-more-conservative != proven). DECISION (Codex review): Option A — replay_guard is reclassified as evidence-only (claim_role=evidence_only, attached_to=nonces) and EXCLUDED from the claim AND; its Kani + differential + binding proofs are carried as evidence for the nonces surface. Zero evidence columns flip on replay_guard.
